skills.title: Write files that satisfy repo style docs on the first try
skills.body:
1. Skip broad exploration. Read the nearest README in the target folder and the conventions doc it names (usually docs/STYLE.md) in one or two turns.
2. Before writing, list every requirement in that doc as a checklist. Include required keys and their exact names, key order, value types (number vs string), indentation width, sorting, $schema or header lines, and trailing newline.
3. Write the file once, satisfying every checklist item. Values like ports must match the task exactly and use the type the doc specifies.
4. Call run_tests.
5. If tests FAIL, do not re-read your own file and guess. Re-read the conventions doc, compare it to your content item by item, and find the one or more mismatches. 6. Rewrite the file, rerun tests, and reply DONE only after they pass.
